stories.headline: US F-15E Strike Eagle Shot Down Over Iran, First Manned Aircraft Loss of the War

key_facts.fact: An F-15E Strike Eagle, a two-seat fighter jet, was shot down over Iran on April 3, marking the first confirmed loss of a US manned aircraft since the Iran war began in late February.
key_facts.excerpt: One U.S. Crew Member Rescued After F-15E Shot Down Over Iran... the first confirmed loss of a U.S. manned aircraft

key_facts.fact: One crew member was rescued by American forces; a search-and-rescue mission remains ongoing for the second crew member.
key_facts.excerpt: US fighter jet shot down over Iran, US sources say

key_facts.fact: Iran's IRGC claimed responsibility for shooting down the aircraft. Iran initially misidentified it as an F-35 stealth fighter.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) claimed responsibility, though the U.S. initially denied some Iranian shootdown claims as false

key_facts.fact: Verified imagery showed US refueling aircraft and helicopters flying low over Iran consistent with combat search-and-rescue operations. Iranian state media broadcast appeals urging civilians to help locate surviving crew, offering rewards.
key_facts.excerpt: Verified imagery showed U.S. refueling aircraft and helicopters flying low over Iran... Iranian state media broadcast appeals urging civilians to help locate surviving crew members, offering rewards for their capture

stories.headline: IRGC Launches Wave 91 Missile Strikes on Tel Aviv, Haifa and US Bases Across Gulf Region

key_facts.fact: Iran's IRGC launched coordinated Wave 91 of Operation True Promise 4, firing heavy ballistic missiles and attack drones at Tel Aviv, Haifa, and multiple US military bases across the Gulf region on April 2.
key_facts.excerpt: IRGC launches missile strikes on Tel Aviv, Haifa in 'Wave 91' of Operation True Promise 4... massive missile and drone strikes on Israeli cities and US bases across the region

key_facts.fact: Israeli airbases including Tel Nof, Palmachim, and Ben Gurion airport were heavily struck, along with military targets in Eilat, the Negev region, and Beersheba.
key_facts.excerpt: Israel's sensitive airbases, including Tel Nof, Palmachim, and Ben Gurion airport, were heavily struck

key_facts.fact: US bases at Ahmed al-Jaber and Ali al-Salem in Kuwait and al-Kharj in Saudi Arabia were hit. The IRGC claimed the early warning radar at al-Dhafra base in the UAE was completely destroyed.
key_facts.excerpt: US bases at Ahmed al-Jaber and Ali al-Salem in Kuwait, as well as the al-Kharj base in Saudi Arabia, were hit by precise heavy ballistic missile strikes

key_facts.fact: The IRGC claimed the strikes forced 5 million Israeli settlers to seek shelter in underground bunkers.
key_facts.excerpt: the strikes forced 5 million Israeli settlers to seek shelter in underground bunkers

key_facts.fact: Yemen's Ansarullah announced a joint operation alongside Iran and Hezbollah targeting Tel Aviv's Jaffa region and launched attacks toward Dimona.
key_facts.excerpt: A military spokesperson for Yemen's Ansarullah announced that, alongside Iran and Hezbollah, a joint operation was carried out against critical enemy targets in Tel Aviv's Jaffa region

stories.headline: Brent Spot Oil Hits $141, Highest Since 2008; US Crude Tops $110 With Record Prompt Spread

key_facts.fact: Dated Brent, the spot price for physical cargo, soared to $141.36 on April 2, the highest level since the 2008 financial crisis, driven by supply tightness from Iran's closure of the Strait of Hormuz.
key_facts.excerpt: The spot price reflects the demand for Brent oil that will be delivered in the next 10 to 30 days... highest level since 2008

key_facts.fact: The Brent spot price traded $32.33 above the June futures contract at $109.03, pointing to severe physical supply tightness not reflected in futures.
key_facts.excerpt: The price was $32.33 higher than the Brent crude futures contract for June delivery, which closed at $109.03

key_facts.fact: US WTI crude surged 11.9% to cross $112 per barrel. The prompt spread between WTI's two nearest contracts exceeded $16, the widest premium on record dating back to 1984.
key_facts.excerpt: The near month and second month U.S. crude oil contracts traded at the biggest spread in history dating back to 1984

key_facts.fact: The surge followed Trump's vow to continue bombing Iran, triggering rapid unwinding of bearish bets and fears of tighter US supplies as overseas buyers rushed for American crude.
key_facts.excerpt: Near-term oil prices hit record premium over later deliveries after Trump vows more attacks on Iran

stories.headline: US Adds 178,000 Jobs in March, Tripling Expectations; Unemployment Falls to 4.3%

key_facts.fact: The US economy added 178,000 nonfarm payroll jobs in March, far exceeding the Dow Jones consensus estimate of 59,000 and reversing February's revised decline of 133,000.
key_facts.excerpt: Jobs report March 2026: 178,000 jobs added

key_facts.fact: The unemployment rate edged down to 4.3%, though largely driven by a sharp reduction in the labor force. An alternative measure counting discouraged workers rose to 8%.
key_facts.excerpt: March US Jobs Report: 178,000 Rise in Payrolls, Much Stronger Than Expected

key_facts.fact: Health care led job gains with 76,000 new positions. Average hourly earnings rose 0.2% month-over-month and 3.5% year-over-year, less than expected.
key_facts.excerpt: Health care was responsible for much of the growth, with the sector adding 76,000 jobs

key_facts.fact: Federal government employment is down 355,000 (11.8%) since peaking in October 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: Since reaching a peak in October 2024, federal government employment is down by 355,000, or 11.8 percent

key_facts.fact: US stock markets were closed for Good Friday on April 3, leaving investors unable to trade on the data. Thursday's session saw the S&P 500 rise 0.11% and the Nasdaq gain 0.18%.
key_facts.excerpt: US Stock Market Closed Today April 3 2026 for Good Friday as Strong March Jobs Data Looms Over Iran War

stories.headline: Amazon Adds 3.5% Fuel Surcharge for US and Canada Sellers Starting April 17 Amid Iran Oil Crisis

key_facts.fact: Amazon announced a 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge on fulfillment fees for third-party sellers in the US and Canada, effective April 17, citing elevated costs from the Iran war.
key_facts.excerpt: With the Iran war now in its fifth week, Amazon is adding a 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge for third-party sellers in the U.S. and Canada. The surcharge takes effect April 17

key_facts.fact: The surcharge applies to Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) orders and comes as the Iran war enters its fifth week with crude oil prices surging past $110 per barrel.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon to apply 3.5% fuel and logistics surcharge on fulfillment

key_facts.fact: Amazon framed the surcharge as temporary, tied to 'elevated costs in fuel and logistics' driven by the Middle East conflict's impact on global energy markets.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon to add 3.5% FBA surcharge starting April 17, 2026, as fuel costs rise amid US-Iran war

stories.headline: Bipartisan MATCH Act Seeks to Ban DUV Lithography Equipment Exports to China

key_facts.fact: The Multilateral Alignment of Technology Controls on Hardware (MATCH) Act was introduced by Rep. Michael Baumgartner (R-WA) in the House, with a companion Senate bill by Sen. Pete Ricketts (R-NE) and Sen. Andy Kim (D-NJ).
key_facts.excerpt: Rep. Michael Baumgartner (R-Wash.) led the House effort, with co-sponsorship from Rep. John Moolenaar (R-Mich.). A companion Senate bill was set to be introduced by Sen. Pete Ricketts (R-Neb.) and Sen. Andy Kim (D-N.J.)

key_facts.fact: The bill targets deep ultraviolet immersion lithography (DUV) machines, which can manufacture advanced but not cutting-edge chips. The US already restricts EUV machines.
key_facts.excerpt: The bill primarily targets machines used in lithography... Specifically, it would ban exports of deep ultraviolet immersion lithography (DUV) machines

key_facts.fact: China's imports of chipmaking equipment grew from $10.7 billion in 2016 to approximately $51.1 billion in 2025, according to Silverado Policy Accelerator analysis.
key_facts.excerpt: China's imports of the equipment grew from $10.7 billion in 2016 to about $51.1 billion last year

key_facts.fact: China was ASML's largest market in Q4 2025, representing 36% of the Dutch company's net system sales.
key_facts.excerpt: China was ASML's largest market in Q4 2025, representing 36% of that company's net system sales

stories.headline: Anthropic Acquires AI Biotech Startup Coefficient Bio for ~$400M in All-Stock Deal

key_facts.fact: Anthropic acquired Coefficient Bio, an AI-driven biotech startup with fewer than 10 employees, for approximately $400 million in an all-stock transaction.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic paid $400 million in an all-stock transaction for a team of fewer than 10 people

key_facts.fact: Coefficient Bio was founded roughly eight months ago by Samuel Stanton and Nathan C. Frey, both former Genentech Prescient Design researchers. Frey led research on biological foundation models and won an ICLR Outstanding Paper Award in 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: Samuel Stanton and Nathan C. Frey co-founded the company. Both previously worked at Genentech's Prescient Design unit, where Frey led research on biological foundation models

key_facts.fact: The startup built a platform enabling AI to draft drug R&D plans, manage clinical regulatory strategies, and identify new drug candidates.
key_facts.excerpt: The stealth startup created a platform enabling AI to draft drug research and development plans, manage clinical regulatory strategies, and identify new drug candidates

key_facts.fact: Investor Dimension held roughly half the company and reported a 38,513% internal rate of return on its investment.
key_facts.excerpt: Dimension, a venture firm, held roughly half the company and reported a 38,513% internal rate of return on its investment

key_facts.fact: Anthropic's healthcare lead Eric Kauderer-Abrams stated the goal: 'We want a meaningful percentage of all of the life science work in the world to run on Claude.'
key_facts.excerpt: We want a meaningful percentage of all of the life science work in the world to run on Claude, in the same way that that happens today with coding

stories.headline: Microsoft Unveils $10B Japan AI Investment Through 2029 With SoftBank and Sakura Internet

key_facts.fact: Microsoft announced a four-year, $10 billion (approximately 1.6 trillion yen) investment in Japan through 2029, covering AI infrastructure, cybersecurity, and workforce training.
key_facts.excerpt: Microsoft deepens its commitment to Japan with $10 billion investment in AI infrastructure, cybersecurity, and workforce

key_facts.fact: Microsoft will partner with SoftBank and Sakura Internet to build data centers in Japan. Sakura Internet shares jumped 20% on the news.
key_facts.excerpt: Japan's Sakura Internet jumps 20% as Microsoft plans $10 billion AI push with SoftBank

key_facts.fact: The plan includes training more than 1 million engineers, developers, and workers across Japan's strategic industries by 2030.
key_facts.excerpt: training more than one million engineers, developers, and workers across Japan's most strategically important industries by 2030

key_facts.fact: Microsoft is deepening its cybersecurity collaboration with Japan's National Police Agency (NPA) through its Digital Crime Unit. The investment builds on $2.9 billion Microsoft invested in Japan in April 2024.
key_facts.excerpt: deepening its collaboration with Japan's National Police Agency (NPA) to help disrupt cybercrime... builds on the $2.9 billion investment Microsoft made in Japan in April 2024

stories.headline: NLRB Orders Amazon to Negotiate With Teamsters at Staten Island Warehouse; Amazon to Appeal

key_facts.fact: The National Labor Relations Board ruled that Amazon must recognize and bargain with the International Brotherhood of Teamsters at its JFK8 warehouse in Staten Island, representing approximately 5,000 workers.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon must negotiate with Staten Island warehouse workers, NLRB says

key_facts.fact: The ruling came from the Trump administration's NLRB, ordering Amazon to bargain with the Teamsters union. Amazon plans to appeal the decision.
key_facts.excerpt: NLRB Orders Amazon to Bargain with Union... Amazon will likely appeal the decision

key_facts.fact: The warehouse workers at JFK8 originally voted to form the Amazon Labor Union in April 2022, which later affiliated with the Teamsters.

stories.headline: France Launches 12 GW of Renewable Energy Tenders With Limits on Chinese Components

key_facts.fact: France announced tenders for 10 GW of offshore wind across seven projects, plus 1.2 GW of solar and 0.8 GW of onshore wind, totaling approximately 12 GW.
key_facts.excerpt: France launches 12 GW of renewable tenders, champions 'Made in Europe' initiative

key_facts.fact: France introduced a resilience criterion giving priority to bids using European-sourced components. For offshore wind, a maximum of 4 out of 9 strategic components can come from China, and Chinese permanent magnets are limited to 50%.
key_facts.excerpt: a maximum of four out of nine strategic components can come from China. The share of Chinese permanent magnets in offshore wind turbines will also be limited to 50 per cent

key_facts.fact: The tenders are two years late due to political gridlock over financing. Finance Minister Roland Lescure said the projects would help wean France off imported oil and gas.
key_facts.excerpt: France launches long-delayed renewable tenders as it grapples with high debt

key_facts.fact: France will integrate a full 'Made in Europe' principle into bids from 2030 following the EU's Industrial Accelerator Act.
key_facts.excerpt: a 'Made in Europe' principle France will integrate into bids from 2030 following the EU's Industrial Accelerator Act

key_facts.fact: Sarvam AI is close to raising $300 million to $350 million at a valuation of $1.5 billion to $1.55 billion, with the round expected to close as soon as next week.
key_facts.excerpt: India AI Startup Sarvam Raises Funds at $1.5 Billion Valuation

key_facts.fact: Bessemer Venture Partners is expected to lead the round, with Nvidia, Amazon, and Prosperity7 Ventures also participating.
key_facts.excerpt: Sarvam AI To Raise $350 Million to Build India's AI... Bessemer, Nvidia, Amazon

key_facts.fact: Founded in 2023 by Vivek Raghavan and Pratyush Kumar, Sarvam builds voice-first AI systems supporting 22 Indian languages, with models of 30 billion and 105 billion parameters trained in India.
key_facts.excerpt: Sarvam AI nears $350 million funding round at up to $1.55 billion valuation

key_facts.fact: The round would be the largest private funding for an Indian startup in 2026 and the biggest single investment into a pure-play Indian AI company in history.
